tools_screen_shows_gateway_registry.detail:
fs.write
WRITE · MEDIUM

Atomically write UTF-8 text to a file under the adapter root.

Phiên bản 1.2 · idempotent · tham số: content, path

fs.read
READ · LOW

Read a UTF-8 text file (at most MAX_BYTES) under the adapter root.

Phiên bản 1.1 · idempotent · tham số: path

code.search
READ · LOW

Literal text search in UTF-8 files under a path (skips VCS/cache dirs).

Phiên bản 1.1 · idempotent · tham số: path, pattern

code.symbols
READ · LOW

Index Python classes/functions (with qualified names and lines) and called names, via ast.

Phiên bản 1.2 · idempotent · tham số: path

code.diff
READ · LOW

Unified diff of a file under the root against provided text (the file is only read).

Phiên bản 1.1 · idempotent · tham số: against, path

test.run
EXECUTE · HIGH

Run `python -m unittest discover` on a directory under the root (executes code).

Phiên bản 1.1 · không idempotent · tham số: path

url.read
READ · LOW

HTTP(S) GET of one URL; the whole body (at most 2 MB) or a known failure; UTF-8 text returned exactly.

Phiên bản 1.1 · idempotent · tham số: url
